title.zh: Bessent Says U.S. May Seize About $1B in Iran-Linked Crypto This Week
title.en: Bessent Says U.S. May Seize About $1B in Iran-Linked Crypto This Week

current_state.zh: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Washington may seize roughly $1 billion in Iran-linked cryptocurrency this week as part of an 'absolute isolation campaign' that also includes maritime blockades, flight restrictions and efforts to close Iran's land routes.
current_state.en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Washington may seize roughly $1 billion in Iran-linked cryptocurrency this week as part of an 'absolute isolation campaign' that also includes maritime blockades, flight restrictions and efforts to close Iran's land routes.
